description.value:
A reflective layer behind the retina, the way night animals have.

Gift — Low-light vision, or +1 circumstance to Perception in dim light if you already have it. Tithe — Your eyes flare like an animal's. Anyone with a light facing you sees exactly where you are: −2 circumstance to Stealth while a light source is pointed your way, and you cannot hide from a lantern.

cinderfall.incomplete: The alternate '+1 circumstance to Perception in dim light if you already have low-light vision' branch is not modeled: granting the Sense above is a no-op if the character already has low-light vision from elsewhere, and pf2e's Sense rule element has no 'grant this bonus instead if the sense is redundant' branching (the closest real precedent, pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/backgrounds/feral-child.json, predicates an alternate SENSE, not an alternate bonus, on already having one).
